arithmetic: for u=a*t+b and each usable variable prime ell, ell|u and ell|p each occupy one residue class modulo ell; CRT preserves t modulo the tail gap while avoiding both root classes, and the resulting p progression is primitive
scope_note: Dirichlet's theorem gives infinitely many core primes in the displayed CRT progression, so this excludes prime-parameter coverage by any finite preselected nonbase variable-prime library. It does not exclude unbounded adaptive factors.
